verdict.rationale: Region or residency choice is a fair question for an office suite. The docs show that LibreOffice itself lets users choose where data is written: --outdir sets the output directory and -env:VAR can set a non-default user-profile path. That is user-controlled local placement of documents and profile data, though nothing addresses region or residency explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that data stays local or never syncs to a remote service, any region/residency selection or statement, and independent corroboration of the data-locality posture.
